step1_analysis.description: A 2:1 multiplexer used in a digital clock multiplier to inject a reference clock edge into a ring oscillator. It selects between the reference clock (REF/REF_BAR) and the oscillator feedback (VCO) based on the SEL/SEL_BAR signals.

paper_reference.title: A 2.5GHz 2.2mW/25μW On/Off-State Power 2psrmsLong-Term-Jitter Digital Clock Multiplier with 3-Reference-Cycles Power-On Time

delay_ref.description: Propagation delay from REF to OUT when SEL=1

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ~ Cload * V / I. With W=5um, L=0.5um, Cload ~ 20fF, V=0.9V, I ~ 300uA -> Delay ~ 60ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on 5um/0.5um transistor sizing and 0.9V supply in SKY130.

delay_vco.description: Propagation delay from VCO to OUT when SEL=0

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to delay_ref, as the path uses similarly sized transistors.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric paths for REF and VCO injection.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C * V^2 * f = 20fF * 0.9^2 * 2.5GHz = 40uW. Including short-circuit power, ~60uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated based on load capacitance and 2.5GHz switching frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure propagation delays from REF and VCO to OUT, and dynamic power consumption at 2.5GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Digital Clock Multiplier Injection Multiplexer Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N8 SEL_BAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT_BAR REF N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT_BAR VCO N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT REF_BAR N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT VCO N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 SEL_BAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 SEL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N7 SEL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N5 SEL_BAR VCTRL VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 SEL VCTRL VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 OUT VCO N6 VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 OUT_BAR REF N1 VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 OUT_BAR VCO N2 VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N1 SEL_BAR VCTRL VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N2 SEL VCTRL VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 OUT REF_BAR N5 VCTRL sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}

* Sources
VVCTRL VCTRL 0 0.9

* SEL=1 (REF selected) for 0-2ns, SEL=0 (VCO selected) for 2-4ns
VSEL SEL 0 pwl(0 0.9 2n 0.9 2.01n 0)
VSEL_BAR SEL_BAR 0 pwl(0 0 2n 0 2.01n 0.9)

* 2.5GHz Clocks (400ps period)
VREF REF 0 pulse(0 0.9 0 20p 20p 180p 400p)
VREF_BAR REF_BAR 0 pulse(0.9 0 0 20p 20p 180p 400p)
VVCO VCO 0 pulse(0 0.9 100p 20p 20p 180p 400p)

* Load Capacitance
Cout OUT 0 10f
Cout_bar OUT_BAR 0 10f

.control
tran 5p 4n

* Measure delay from REF to OUT (during SEL=1 window)
meas tran delay_ref_rise trig v(ref) val=0.45 rise=2 targ v(out) val=0.45 rise=2
meas tran delay_ref_fall trig v(ref) val=0.45 fall=2 targ v(out) val=0.45 fall=2

* Measure delay from VCO to OUT (during SEL=0 window, OUT = NOT(VCO))
meas tran delay_vco_rise trig v(vco) val=0.45 fall=7 targ v(out) val=0.45 rise=7
meas tran delay_vco_fall trig v(vco) val=0.45 rise=7 targ v(out) val=0.45 fall=7

* Measure Rise and Fall times
meas tran trise_out trig v(out) val=0.18 rise=2 targ v(out) val=0.72 rise=2
meas tran tfall_out trig v(out) val=0.72 fall=2 targ v(out) val=0.18 fall=2

* Measure Average Power
meas tran ivctrl_avg avg i(VVCTRL)
let power = -ivctrl_avg * 0.9
print power

quit
.endc
